headword: {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}

definitions.gloss: rushing onto a departing train; last-second boarding
definitions.explanation: running to catch a train just as the doors are about to close, considered dangerous and often discouraged

examples.japanese: {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧です。
examples.english: Rushing onto a departing train is dangerous.

examples.japanese: {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦やめ→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please refrain from rushing onto departing trains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧しそうで、つい{駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was about to be late, so I ended up rushing onto the train at the last second.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}む→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧ (to rush in) + ⟦{乗車|じょうしゃ}→乗車：06201_jousha⟧ (boarding a train)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS (station announcements):
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧です⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でお⟦やめ→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please do not rush onto the train, it is dangerous
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please wait for the next train

USAGE:
Discouraged because passengers get caught in closing doors and the train is delayed.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{発車|はっしゃ}→発車：03694_hassha⟧⟦ベル→ベル：01379_beru⟧ - departure bell
- ⟦ホームドア→ホームドア：08491_hoomudoa⟧ - platform screen doors
- ⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れる→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧ - to miss a train
- {次発|じはつ} - next train
